US-China AI talks precede Xi summit, focus on safeguards

Ahead of a summit between the U.S. and China, discussions have taken place regarding artificial intelligence (AI). One congressman has called for nuclear-style safeguards for AI, drawing parallels to arms control. These talks and calls for safety measures are seen as potentially informing the upcoming summit.
